_about: Pre-analysis design checks (R/design_checks.R, bioana_check_design()). A check with status 'stop' prevents the analysis; 'warn' is reported in summary$diagnostics and the report line.
_note_subject_pattern: sample-metadata columns that name the biological unit. If one repeats across samples and is not in a random term of analysis.model: samples that differ in a fixed term (time, treatment) are repeated measures of one unit -> stop; samples that do not differ are technical replicates -> stop for omics data (sum or average them first), allowed for the outcome when declared as unit_id (subsamples are averaged or nested).
_note_min_residual_df: fewer residual degrees of freedom than this -> warn; none -> stop
_note_min_units_per_level: a treatment level with fewer distinct experimental units -> warn (its effect rests on the variance of the other levels)
_note_min_random_levels: a random term with fewer levels -> warn (its variance is poorly estimated; a fixed effect may be better)
